title: Process-Level Trajectory Evaluation for Environment Configuration in Software Engineering Agents
authors_zh: Jiayi Kuang, Yinghui Li, Xin Zhang, Yangning Li, Di Yin, Xing Sun, Ying Shen, Philip S. Yu
paper_type_zh: 软件环境配置智能体的过程级评测基准与任务数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究环境型软件工程 agent、过程 verifier、可执行终止条件、benchmark replay 与发布审计的读者
one_line: EnConda-Bench turns pinned Python repositories and minimally corrupted READMEs into 4,201 environment-repair tasks scored by error labels, LLM-judged fixes, and Docker build/test success; the public release contains task records rather than replayable agent episodes.
EnConda-Bench 将固定版本的 Python 仓库与最小化破坏的 README 组织成 4,201 个环境修复任务，以错误标签、LLM 语义判断和 Docker 构建/测试终止条件评分；公开发布的是任务与金标修复记录，不是可回放的 agent trajectory。
why: It shows how environment-agent evaluation can expose the gap between diagnosing a dependency/setup error and executing a robust repair, while making clear that repository pins, containers, package/network state, terminal predicates, and retained failures all belong to the reasoning-data contract.
inclusion_reason: EnConda-Bench makes environment configuration diagnosable at both the error/repair level and the executable terminal level, and it releases a large task corpus plus its construction and process-evaluation code. Its missing rollout corpus, unresolved execution gitlink, count/version drift, and environment-security gaps are also important audit lessons for environment-agent reasoning data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
EnConda-Bench studies a concrete failure boundary for software-engineering agents: an agent may recognize that a README contains a dependency, command, path, ordering, or version error yet still fail to turn that diagnosis into a shell script that builds and tests the repository. The formal record is an ICLR 2026 Poster, while the Card retains year 2025 because arXiv:2510.25694v1 was submitted on 2025-10-29. This distinction matters because the checked repository commit, 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2, dates from 2025-10-30 and predates the final conference revision.

The benchmark instance is a task record, not a released interaction episode. Paper-time evaluation combines a pinned Python repository, a base Docker environment, an erroneous README, and structured gold error/repair annotations. In the checked release, each main JSONL row contains only readme, repo_name, level, and errors; each error contains error_type, error_description, correction_candidates, and golden_answer. README text lives in a parallel directory tree, and repository revisions live in a separate repo_info.jsonl. No action, observation, retry, patch, stdout/stderr, container state, test result, or terminal verdict is present in the task row.

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because it defines an environment-grounded evaluation surface and makes process and terminal feedback explicit. It does not establish a public trajectory-training corpus: Appendix C describes a framework capable of generating successful and failed trajectories, but the official tree at the checked commit contains no such rollout collection. It also does not evaluate general code correctness; the target is environment configuration under injected README faults, with final success defined by build, test, and normal-exit conditions.

The Atlas value is therefore twofold. EnConda-Bench provides a countable task corpus with gold diagnoses and repairs, and it exposes the gap between process-level recognition and executable recovery. The current L4 content boundary is supported by the paper, appendix, ICLR record, full-corpus schema/count inspection, and pinned code audit; it deliberately leaves end-to-end replay, experiment trajectories, exact executor provenance, and paper-to-release reconciliation unresolved.

EnConda-Bench 研究软件工程 agent 的一个具体失效边界：agent 即使识别出 README 中存在依赖、命令、路径、顺序或版本错误，也未必能把诊断转化为真正完成仓库构建与测试的 shell 脚本。论文的正式发表记录是 ICLR 2026 Poster；本 Card 的年份仍为 2025，因为 arXiv:2510.25694v1 首次提交于 2025-10-29。这个区分很重要：本次核验的仓库 commit 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2 形成于 2025-10-30，早于最终会议版本。

一个 benchmark instance 是任务记录，而不是已发布的交互 episode。论文评测中的任务由固定 revision 的 Python 仓库、基础 Docker 环境、含错误的 README 和结构化金标错误/修复注释组成。核验版本的主 JSONL 每行只有 readme、repo_name、level 和 errors；每个 error 又包含 error_type、error_description、correction_candidates 与 golden_answer。README 正文位于并行目录树，仓库 revision 则放在独立的 repo_info.jsonl 中。任务行没有 action、observation、retry、patch、stdout/stderr、容器状态、测试结果或 terminal verdict。

它归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，是因为它定义了受环境约束的评测表面，并明确区分 process feedback 与 terminal feedback。它并不证明存在公开的 trajectory-training corpus：Appendix C 说明框架可以生成成功和失败 trajectory，但在核验 commit 的官方目录中没有这类 rollout 集合。它也不是通用代码正确性评测；目标是注入 README 错误后的环境配置，最终成功条件是构建成功、测试正确执行并正常退出。

因此，它对 Atlas 的价值有两层：一是发布了可计数、带金标诊断与修复的任务语料；二是暴露从过程级识别到可执行恢复之间的差距。当前 L4 正文的证据边界来自论文、appendix、ICLR 记录、全量语料 schema/count 核验和固定版本代码审计；端到端 replay、实验 trajectory、精确 executor 来源以及论文与发布版本的对应关系仍明确保留为未知。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
EnConda-Bench turns minimally corrupted repository setup instructions into tasks that can be scored at two different surfaces: whether the agent diagnoses and proposes fixes for the injected errors, and whether its final script actually configures and tests the repository.

Construction starts from selected Python repositories whose original setup instructions are manually checked. Claude-4-Sonnet and Gemini 2.5 Pro minimally edit READMEs and attach error types, descriptions, candidate corrections, and gold repairs. GPT-4.1-mini generates a README-faithful setup script and helps filter injections: the erroneous version must block progress, and the repair must permit progress through the affected step. Human review follows the automated checks. The released object is the resulting erroneous README plus per-error gold metadata and separately maintained repository/revision context.

The feedback contract is mixed. Error-type precision, recall, and F1 compare categorical sets. An LLM judge assesses semantic accuracy of predicted error descriptions and fix suggestions. The terminal predicate is environmental: a generated shell script passes only when environment construction succeeds, tests run correctly, and the process exits normally. These signals can observe category agreement, semantic correspondence, and an eventual executable outcome; they cannot recover an unreleased command-observation history, prove that a repair is safe or reproducible under future package state, or establish that every intermediate diagnosis caused the terminal result.

Compared with environment-configuration benchmarks discussed by the paper, including EnvBench, INSTALLAMATIC, ExecutionAgent, and SetupBench, the directional change is the joint treatment of error localization/repair semantics and end-to-end execution rather than a single final outcome. The closest Atlas companions are SetupAgent/SWE-bench and BuildBench: all connect repository tasks to environmental predicates, but EnConda-Bench releases synthetic README error annotations at 4,201-task scale. Its category value comes from that feedback design and its audit gaps, not from reclassifying the released task rows as full trajectories.

EnConda-Bench 把经过最小化破坏的仓库安装说明变成双层可评分任务：既检查 agent 是否诊断出注入错误并提出修复，也检查最终脚本是否真正完成仓库配置与测试。

构建流程从经过筛选、原始安装说明已由人工检查的 Python 仓库开始。Claude-4-Sonnet 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 对 README 做最小改动，并附上错误类型、错误描述、候选修复和金标答案。GPT-4.1-mini 生成严格遵循 README 的安装脚本并参与过滤：错误版本必须阻断执行，修复后则必须能够越过受影响步骤；自动检查之后还有人工复核。公开对象是错误 README、逐错误金标元数据，以及另行维护的仓库/revision 上下文。

反馈契约是 mixed verifier。错误类型用 precision、recall 与 F1 比较类别集合；错误描述与修复建议的语义正确性由 LLM judge 判断；terminal predicate 则依赖环境执行，只有生成脚本成功构建环境、正确运行测试且进程正常退出才算通过。它能观测类别一致性、语义对应关系和最终可执行结果，但无法还原未发布的 command-observation 历史，也不能证明修复在未来 package 状态下仍安全可复现，或证明每个中间诊断都直接导致最终成功。

与论文讨论的 EnvBench、INSTALLAMATIC、ExecutionAgent 和 SetupBench 等环境配置 benchmark 相比，EnConda-Bench 的方向性变化是把错误定位/修复语义与端到端执行共同纳入评分，而不是只看一个最终 outcome。在 Atlas 中最适合一起阅读的是 SetupAgent/SWE-bench 与 BuildBench：三者都把仓库任务连接到环境 predicate，但 EnConda-Bench 以 4,201 个任务规模发布了合成 README 错误注释。它对该类别的价值来自反馈接口与审计边界，不能据此把公开任务行重新解释为完整 trajectory。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. Candidate Python repositories come from GitHub and existing manually verified environment benchmarks. The paper filters for at least 10 stars, more than 1,000 commits, and more than 10 closed issues. Professional annotators attempt the original setup and remove repositories with faulty instructions or incomplete dependencies. Exact source-mixture counts, annotator count, time budget, and rejected-repository manifest are not disclosed.

Generation and collection. Claude-4-Sonnet and Gemini 2.5 Pro minimally modify an original README, initially inserting exactly two errors. The generation response contains an error type, natural-language description, correction candidates, and a golden answer. The taxonomy is E1 dependency installation, E2 command/syntax, E4 path or missing file, E6 logical order, E7 version compatibility, and E8 other. Model allocation, temperature, seed, retries, and decoding parameters are unknown.

Execution validation and selection. GPT-4.1-mini produces a Bash script that follows the README for Ubuntu 22.04/Miniconda. The script is executed in Docker. An injection is retained only when the erroneous instructions fail and the proposed repair allows execution to progress through the affected step. GPT-4.1-mini then checks README support, error validity, type, and gold fix; humans review the survivors. The authors report 98.5% LLM-human agreement, but do not provide sample size, adjudication protocol, agreement formula, or confusion matrix. From 1,772 two-error README variants, 1,230 valid variants remain; errors are then split and merged into tasks of different levels.

Released outputs. The checked commit releases 4,201 main JSONL rows, 4,201 per-task JSON files, 4,201 matching README files, and 9,471 error objects. The main task row has readme, repo_name, level, and errors; it has no record-level repository URL, revision, Dockerfile, split, trajectory, result, or environment snapshot. Revisions are in a separate 329-row manifest, so reuse must normalize names to construct a task-to-revision relation. Evaluated agents output detected-error JSON and a corrected shell script; the current AnalysisResult schema also retains raw output and token usage, but those processing fields are not an environment trajectory.

Verifier and evaluation. Process scoring combines error-type precision/recall/F1 with LLM-judged description and fix accuracy. The checked matcher accepts a hard-coded combined score above 0.5: exact type contributes 0.6, description similarity 0.3 times confidence, and fix similarity 0.1 times confidence. The released evaluator defaults to gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0.1, and 500 output tokens, although the paper names GPT-4.1-mini; a configured 0.7 similarity threshold is not applied by the inspected path, which trusts the judge boolean. Terminal Pass@1 requires successful build, correct test execution, and normal exit. The exact end-to-end execution implementation is unavailable because Evaluation/Execution is gitlink 99729fb0454fb5ef3d031a7b62cb7532fe8fc114 without a .gitmodules mapping.

Environment, budget, and reuse. The released Dockerfile starts from Ubuntu 22.04 and installs Python standalone builds, Miniconda 25.3.1-1, Poetry, uv, pipenv, Pyright, Node 20, jq, and build tools using live endpoints. Repository defaults include API timeout 120 s, environment timeout 300 s, Bash timeout 60 s, five iterations, three retries, and a seed used only for optional sampling; these are not verified paper-experiment settings. The public use supported by the release is evaluation. Reproduction must pin commit 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2, supply the missing executor, lock image/packages/network/cache/reset behavior, and retain every script, observation, test log, verdict, and run identifier.

输入。 候选 Python 仓库来自 GitHub 与已有人工验证的环境 benchmark。论文使用至少 10 stars、超过 1,000 commits、超过 10 个 closed issues 的筛选条件。专业标注员尝试按原始说明完成配置，剔除 README 本身有错或依赖不完整的仓库。各来源占比、标注员人数、操作时间预算和被拒仓库清单均未披露。

生成与采集。 Claude-4-Sonnet 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 对原始 README 做最小修改，起初每份恰好注入两个错误。生成结果包含错误类型、自然语言描述、候选修复与金标答案。类别为：E1 依赖安装、E2 命令/语法、E4 路径或缺失文件、E6 逻辑顺序、E7 版本兼容、E8 其他。两种模型的任务分配、temperature、seed、retry 和 decoding 参数均为 unknown。

执行验证与筛选。 GPT-4.1-mini 为 Ubuntu 22.04/Miniconda 生成严格遵循 README 的 Bash 脚本，并在 Docker 中执行。只有错误说明确实造成失败、修复后能够通过受影响步骤时，该注入才会保留。随后 GPT-4.1-mini 检查错误是否有 README 依据、是否有效、类型是否正确、金标修复是否成立，人工再复核留下的样本。作者报告 LLM 与人工一致率为 98.5%，但没有披露样本量、adjudication 流程、一致率公式或 confusion matrix。流程从 1,772 份双错误 README 中保留 1,230 份有效版本，再对错误集合拆分和合并，形成不同 level 的任务。

发布输出。 核验 commit 含 4,201 行主 JSONL、4,201 个逐任务 JSON、4,201 份对应 README 与 9,471 个 error object。主任务行只有 readme、repo_name、level、errors，没有逐条 repository URL、revision、Dockerfile、split、trajectory、result 或 environment snapshot。revision 单独保存在 329 行 manifest 中，所以复用者必须规范化名称后才能建立 task-to-revision 关系。被测 agent 输出检测错误 JSON 与修正后的 shell 脚本；当前 AnalysisResult schema 还保存 raw output 与 token usage，但这些 processing field 不是环境 trajectory。

Verifier 与评测。 过程评分把错误类型 precision/recall/F1 与 LLM judge 的描述/修复 accuracy 结合。核验代码使用硬编码的综合 match score >0.5：类型精确匹配贡献 0.6，描述相似度贡献 0.3 × confidence，修复相似度贡献 0.1 × confidence。公开 evaluator 默认 gpt-4o-mini、temperature 0.1、最多 500 个输出 token，而论文写的是 GPT-4.1-mini；配置中的 0.7 similarity threshold 没有在核验路径中执行，该路径直接采信 judge boolean。Terminal Pass@1 要求构建成功、测试正确执行、进程正常退出。端到端执行实现无法从当前 snapshot 获得，因为 Evaluation/Execution 是 gitlink 99729fb0454fb5ef3d031a7b62cb7532fe8fc114，仓库没有相应 .gitmodules mapping。

环境、预算与复用。 公开 Dockerfile 以 Ubuntu 22.04 为基础，通过在线 endpoint 安装 Python standalone build、Miniconda 25.3.1-1、Poetry、uv、pipenv、Pyright、Node 20、jq 和构建工具。仓库默认值包括 API timeout 120 秒、environment timeout 300 秒、Bash timeout 60 秒、最多 5 次 iteration、3 次 retry，以及仅用于可选 sampling 的 seed；这些并未被证实是论文实验设置。公开发布只支持 evaluation。复现者必须固定 commit 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2、补齐缺失 executor、锁定 image/package/network/cache/reset 行为，并保留每个 script、observation、test log、verdict 和 run ID。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports two linked but non-equivalent evaluation surfaces. In Table 3, Repo2Run with Claude-4 obtains error-type F1 60.6, description accuracy 52.2, fix accuracy 47.3, and Pass@1 22.9. OpenHands with DeepSeek-V3 obtains F1 58.7, description accuracy 51.9, fix accuracy 33.8, and Pass@1 9.1. These are author-reported results under the paper's agent/model configurations; the checked public snapshot does not contain the complete executor or experiment logs required for independent reproduction.

The score pattern supports a bounded conclusion: agents often perform better at identifying or describing setup faults than at producing an executable repair that satisfies the terminal predicate. The paper's case analysis reports overprediction, excessive use of E8 “other,” missed repository-wide path errors, correct diagnosis without command localization, incomplete repair of multi-error READMEs, omission of a suggested fix from the final script, and introduction of new faults. Figure 7 further reports that more output tokens tend to improve description accuracy without consistently improving Pass@1. This is not evidence that the released data are intrinsically high quality or that more tokens reliably solve environment configuration.

The release-scale evidence is independently countable from official artifacts. At commit 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2, full-corpus parsing yields 4,201 main JSONL rows and exactly 9,471 error objects. The directory tree contains 4,201 JSON annotations and 4,201 README texts: 3,216 Markdown, 978 RST, 6 AsciiDoc, and 1 Org file. The released level counts are level0 48; level1 2,072; level2 1,222; level3 94; level4 234; level5 100; level6 173; level7 80; level8 80; level9 38; and level10 60. The error counts are E1 1,969; E2 2,607; E4 1,491; E6 1,602; E7 1,490; and E8 312.

Those checks also reveal unresolved drift. The paper reports 323 repositories, whereas the main JSONL has 320 distinct repo_name values, the expanded tree has 321 repository directories, and repo_info.jsonl has 329 repository/revision rows. The paper describes levels 1-10, yet the release includes 48 level0 records. E8 matches the paper's 312, but current E1/E2 counts do not fit the paper's approximate “around 1,600” description for the five standard types. No tag, release, changelog, or manifest explains these mappings. The evidence therefore supports the 4,201-task/9,471-error release boundary but not silent equivalence among paper, repository, level, and version statistics.

论文报告了两种相互关联但不可等同的评测表面。Table 3 中，Repo2Run + Claude-4 的错误类型 F1 为 60.6、描述 accuracy 为 52.2、修复 accuracy 为 47.3、Pass@1 为 22.9；OpenHands + DeepSeek-V3 的对应结果为 58.7、51.9、33.8 和 9.1。这些数字是作者在论文 agent/model 配置下报告的结果；核验的公开 snapshot 不含独立复现所需的完整 executor 与实验日志。

分数差异只支持一个有边界的结论：agent 对安装错误的识别或描述通常强于满足 terminal predicate 的可执行修复。论文案例分析记录了 error overprediction、过度使用 E8 “other”、遗漏跨仓库路径错误、诊断正确却无法定位命令、没有修完多错误 README 的全部问题、最终脚本未采用自己提出的修复，以及引入新错误。Figure 7 还显示，更多输出 token 往往改善 description accuracy，却不稳定改善 Pass@1。这既不能证明发布数据天然高质量，也不能证明增加 token 就能可靠解决环境配置。

发布规模可由官方 artifact 独立计数。对 commit 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2 的全量解析得到 4,201 行主 JSONL 与恰好 9,471 个 error object。目录树含 4,201 个 JSON 注释和 4,201 份 README：3,216 份 Markdown、978 份 RST、6 份 AsciiDoc、1 份 Org。level 分布为 level0 48、level1 2,072、level2 1,222、level3 94、level4 234、level5 100、level6 173、level7 80、level8 80、level9 38、level10 60；错误分布为 E1 1,969、E2 2,607、E4 1,491、E6 1,602、E7 1,490、E8 312。

同一轮核验也暴露出尚未解释的 drift。论文报告 323 个仓库，主 JSONL 中却有 320 个不同 repo_name，展开目录有 321 个仓库目录，repo_info.jsonl 有 329 条 repository/revision 记录。论文描述 level 1-10，而发布中有 48 条 level0。E8 的 312 与论文一致，但当前 E1/E2 计数不符合论文对五类标准错误均“around 1,600”的近似描述。仓库没有 tag、release、changelog 或 manifest 解释这些对应关系。因此证据支持“公开 4,201 个任务、9,471 个错误”这一 release boundary，但不支持默认认定 paper、repository、level 和 version 统计彼此完全等价。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline for environment-configuration agents is often terminal and coarse: a system either reaches a runnable environment or does not. The paper situates EnConda-Bench against EnvBench, INSTALLAMATIC, ExecutionAgent, and SetupBench. Its concrete change is to inject typed, minimally edited setup faults with gold descriptions and repairs, then score both the agent's diagnosis/fix semantics and the final executable outcome.

The new data object is therefore not a generic chain of thought. It is an erroneous repository README linked to {error_type, error_description, correction_candidates, golden_answer} records, with repository revisions and README text carried in parallel artifacts. The new feedback interface separates set-based type metrics, LLM-judged semantic metrics, and Docker build/test/exit success. This separation is useful for studying where a model fails between recognizing a fault and operationalizing the repair.

Several components are established practice rather than new in isolation: filtering GitHub repositories, generating synthetic corruptions with frontier models, running setup scripts in containers, using human review, and judging natural-language similarity with an LLM. The scale increase to 4,201 tasks and 9,471 errors is an engineering contribution, not proof of novelty or quality by itself. Likewise, Appendix C's proposal to collect successful and failed trajectories does not make those trajectories part of the public release.

The direction signal for reasoning-data research is the explicit decomposition of feedback across answer-level labels and an episode-level terminal predicate. Before reusing the design, however, one must check judge calibration and multiplicity handling, recover the end-to-end execution gitlink, reconcile repository/level/version counts, lock the mutable environment, retain both successful and failed runs, and establish task-to-revision-to-container-to-verdict lineage. Without those checks, the benchmark cannot support claims about replayable trajectories or training-ready process supervision.

环境配置 agent 的既有评测常采用粗粒度 terminal 结果：系统要么得到可运行环境，要么失败。论文将 EnConda-Bench 与 EnvBench、INSTALLAMATIC、ExecutionAgent、SetupBench 对照。它的具体变化是注入带类型、且只做最小编辑的安装错误，为错误配套金标描述与修复，再同时评分 agent 的诊断/修复语义和最终可执行结果。

因此，新的数据对象不是泛化的 chain of thought，而是错误 README 与 {error_type, error_description, correction_candidates, golden_answer} 记录；仓库 revision 和 README 正文则位于并行 artifact。新的反馈接口把基于集合的类型 metric、LLM 语义 judge 和 Docker build/test/exit 成功拆开。这样的拆分可用于研究模型是在识别错误之后的哪一步未能把修复落实为可执行操作。

若拆开来看，许多组件属于已有做法：筛选 GitHub 仓库、用 frontier model 合成 corruption、在容器中运行 setup script、加入人工复核、用 LLM 判断自然语言相似性。扩大到 4,201 个任务和 9,471 个错误是工程贡献，但规模本身既不证明 novelty，也不证明 quality。同理，Appendix C 提出收集成功/失败 trajectory，并不等于这些 trajectory 已包含在公开发布中。

它对 reasoning-data 研究的方向信号，是把 answer-level label 与 episode-level terminal predicate 上的反馈显式拆解。复用该设计之前，仍需检查 judge calibration 与同类多错误的 multiplicity handling，找回端到端 execution gitlink，调和仓库/level/version 计数，固定可变环境，保留成功和失败 run，并建立 task-to-revision-to-container-to-verdict lineage。没有这些检查，就不能声称它提供可回放 trajectory 或可直接训练的过程监督。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest release limitation is object mismatch. The paper discusses process-level trajectories and Appendix C describes generating successful and failed trajectories, but the checked release publishes tasks and gold repair metadata, not structured state-action-observation episodes. Prompt/model output fields in current processing records do not substitute for commands, observations, filesystem deltas, retries, patches, tests, stdout/stderr, and terminal verdicts. Failed and successful experimental runs cannot be audited item by item.

The execution contract is not self-contained. Evaluation/Execution is a gitlink at 99729fb0454fb5ef3d031a7b62cb7532fe8fc114, with no .gitmodules mapping in the checked snapshot. Repository defaults use a local environment with testing disabled and safe mode enabled, while the reported terminal evaluation requires Docker and tests. The paper does not disclose experiment-time numeric timeout, partial credit, reset, or replay semantics. Reconstructing Pass@1 therefore requires unverified integration outside the snapshot.

Process scores inherit judge and matching failure modes. The paper names GPT-4.1-mini, while released code defaults to gpt-4o-mini; the declared 0.7 similarity threshold is not applied in the inspected evaluator. The hard-coded combined match threshold above 0.5 gives exact type most of the weight, and set-based type scoring collapses repeated errors of the same category. LLM prompt sensitivity and API drift can change semantic accuracy. A passing live-dependency script may still be unsafe, non-reproducible, or semantically wrong in ways the predicate does not observe.

Release lineage has visible version drift: paper 323 repositories versus 320 JSONL names, 321 tree directories, and 329 revision records; paper levels 1-10 versus 48 released level0 tasks; and unreconciled error distributions. There is no train/dev/test or hidden split, no model-corpus decontamination audit, and no instance-level source-overlap manifest. Public READMEs and gold repairs can overlap model training data; repository pinning is not decontamination.

Environment replay and security remain weakly specified. ubuntu:22.04 is not digest-pinned, pyenv is cloned without a commit, Miniconda lacks a published checksum in the recipe, and apt/PyPI/conda/GitHub resources remain live. Package/channel locks, cache state, egress policy, and per-task reset are unknown. The container runs as root and executes untrusted repository plus model-generated shell content; no privilege reduction, secret isolation, malware scan, supply-chain policy, or artifact quarantine is documented. Curator inference: reuse requires disposable, non-privileged, network-restricted infrastructure.

Finally, Apache-2.0 clearly covers repository code, but the release has no record-level license/attribution manifest for modified README content and upstream repositories. The paper asserts permission, anonymization, desensitization, and cleaning without releasing the item-level procedure. These gaps, together with absent rollout data, block training reuse; benchmark scores must not be treated as evidence of data quality.

最主要的发布限制是 data object 不匹配。论文讨论 process-level trajectory，Appendix C 也描述生成成功和失败 trajectory，但核验发布只提供任务与金标修复元数据，不含结构化 state-action-observation episode。当前 processing record 中的 prompt/model output 字段不能替代 command、observation、filesystem delta、retry、patch、test、stdout/stderr 和 terminal verdict；成功与失败的论文实验 run 无法逐项审计。

execution contract 不是 self-contained。核验 snapshot 的 Evaluation/Execution 是 gitlink 99729fb0454fb5ef3d031a7b62cb7532fe8fc114，且没有 .gitmodules mapping。仓库默认使用 local environment、关闭 testing、开启 safe mode，而论文的 terminal evaluation 要求 Docker 与测试执行。论文也未披露实验时的数值 timeout、partial credit、reset 或 replay 语义。因此，重建 Pass@1 必须依赖 snapshot 之外、尚未核验的集成。

过程分数继承 judge 与 matching 的失效模式。论文写 GPT-4.1-mini，公开代码却默认 gpt-4o-mini；配置声明的 0.7 similarity threshold 未在核验 evaluator 中应用。硬编码综合阈值 >0.5 把主要权重给了类型精确匹配，类型的 set scoring 又会折叠同一类别的多个错误。LLM 的 prompt sensitivity 和 API drift 会改变语义 accuracy。依赖在线 package 状态而通过的脚本，仍可能不安全、不可复现，或在 predicate 不可见的方面语义错误。

发布 lineage 存在可见 version drift：论文 323 个仓库，对应公开 JSONL 的 320 个名称、目录树的 321 个仓库目录、manifest 的 329 条 revision；论文 level 1-10，对应发布中的 48 个 level0 task；error distribution 也没有完整调和。发布没有 train/dev/test 或 hidden split，没有 model-corpus decontamination audit，也没有逐条 source-overlap manifest。公开 README 与金标修复可能已进入模型训练语料；commit pinning 不等于 decontamination。

环境 replay 与 security 也缺乏关键约束。ubuntu:22.04 未固定 digest，pyenv clone 未固定 commit，recipe 中的 Miniconda installer 没有发布 checksum，apt/PyPI/conda/GitHub 资源仍是在线状态；package/channel lock、cache state、egress policy 和逐任务 reset 均为 unknown。容器以 root 运行不可信仓库和模型生成的 shell 内容，却没有披露 privilege reduction、secret isolation、malware scan、supply-chain policy 或 artifact quarantine。基于该执行面，curator inference 是：只能在 disposable、non-privileged、network-restricted 基础设施中复用。

最后，Apache-2.0 明确覆盖官方仓库代码，但发布没有为修改后的 README 与上游仓库提供逐条 license/attribution manifest。论文声明已取得许可并完成 anonymization、desensitization 与 cleaning，却没有公开 item-level procedure。以上问题与缺失 rollout 数据共同阻断 training reuse；benchmark score 不能被视为 data quality 的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, EnConda-Bench is useful as an evaluation and audit blueprint. It shows how to keep a task record, answer-level gold repair labels, a semantic process judge, and an episode-level terminal predicate distinct. A stronger descendant dataset could join each task to a pinned repository, image digest, dependency snapshot, initial filesystem state, command/tool action, stdout/stderr observation, patch, test result, terminal verdict, and run identifier without calling the current public rows trajectories.

The benchmark can support controlled evaluation of error localization, error-type calibration, repair suggestion quality, script synthesis, multi-error coverage, and diagnosis-to-execution conversion. Researchers can replace the LLM judge with calibrated human or deterministic criteria, score repeated same-type errors without set collapse, compare process metrics with Pass@1, and test whether more tokens improve actionable repairs rather than only descriptions.

Its construction pipeline is also a reusable audit checklist: document repository selection and rejected items; freeze original and corrupted READMEs; retain generator model snapshots, prompts, seeds, and retries; publish each automated and human decision; verify that the injection causes failure and the gold repair clears the same step; and preserve rejected, successful, and failed executions. Release-level audits should reconcile all repository and difficulty counts and map each paper revision to an immutable artifact snapshot.

Evaluation reuse should pin commit 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2, main JSONL SHA-256 5d34903b3667a49a61d040bb86a48628cfeff7664adb629afe016d58f8f88e60, manifest SHA-256 f145b829393a1da17aced5cf96d28173c2b4a9ebc7dcb9a849fa7a6f8031b01e, and Dockerfile SHA-256 a12f96c4bd5528e3345e31cd03e1929e53c20efd82fe0e3443d29787fe1794b1. These are curator-computed hashes, not author-published checksums. Reusers must additionally recover the execution gitlink, lock packages/network/cache/reset state, and sandbox all repository and generated shell execution.

The safe reuse class is evaluation only. The paper supports neither SFT demonstrations nor preference, process-reward, RLVR, or agent-policy training examples from the released corpus. Training reuse remains blocked until full successful and failed episodes, split and contamination controls, end-to-end lineage, rights metadata, calibrated judges, and secure replay infrastructure are available.

对于指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，EnConda-Bench 适合作为 evaluation 与 audit blueprint。它展示了如何区分 task record、answer-level 金标修复、语义 process judge 和 episode-level terminal predicate。更完整的后续数据集可以把每个任务连接到固定 repository、image digest、dependency snapshot、初始 filesystem state、command/tool action、stdout/stderr observation、patch、test result、terminal verdict 与 run ID，但不能把当前公开行直接称为 trajectory。

该 benchmark 可用于受控比较 error localization、error-type calibration、repair suggestion quality、script synthesis、多错误覆盖率，以及 diagnosis-to-execution 转换。研究者可以用经校准的人工或 deterministic criteria 替换 LLM judge；避免 set scoring 折叠重复的同类错误；比较 process metric 与 Pass@1；并检查更多 token 究竟改善可执行修复，还是只改善错误描述。

它的 construction pipeline 也可转化为审计清单：记录仓库筛选与被拒 item；冻结原始/错误 README；保留 generator model snapshot、prompt、seed 和 retry；公开每一步自动与人工决定；验证注入错误确实引起失败、金标修复确实清除同一步骤；保存被拒、成功和失败执行。发布级审计还应调和所有 repository 与 difficulty count，并把每个 paper revision 映射到 immutable artifact snapshot。

evaluation 复用应固定 commit 86ab7858613b85f4a8316f3cda3c83086b8cf7c2、主 JSONL SHA-256 5d34903b3667a49a61d040bb86a48628cfeff7664adb629afe016d58f8f88e60、manifest SHA-256 f145b829393a1da17aced5cf96d28173c2b4a9ebc7dcb9a849fa7a6f8031b01e 与 Dockerfile SHA-256 a12f96c4bd5528e3345e31cd03e1929e53c20efd82fe0e3443d29787fe1794b1。这些是 curator 计算值，不是作者发布的 checksum。复用者还必须找回 execution gitlink、锁定 package/network/cache/reset 状态，并在 sandbox 中执行所有仓库代码和生成 shell。

安全复用等级是 仅限 evaluation。论文不支持从公开语料构造 SFT demonstration、preference、process-reward、RLVR 或 agent-policy training example。在获得完整成功/失败 episode、split 与 contamination control、端到端 lineage、rights metadata、校准 judge 和安全 replay 基础设施之前，training reuse 仍处于 blocked 状态。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: The process evaluator mixes exact/set error-type scoring with an LLM semantic judge, so judge version, prompt sensitivity, stochasticity, and API drift can change description/fix accuracy.
Current code defaults to gpt-4o-mini while the paper names GPT-4.1-mini; no calibration set or version-reconciliation report is released.
The declared 0.7 similarity threshold is not used by the inspected evaluator; matching instead uses a hard-coded score threshold above 0.5 and the judge's own boolean.
Error-type precision/recall uses sets of error types, collapsing multiplicity when a README contains multiple errors of the same category.
A shell script can pass mutable dependency/test execution while relying on live package state; success does not prove future replay, security, or that every diagnosis was semantically correct.
Multi-error tasks compound failures: agents may identify types but miss the exact command, omit suggested fixes from the final script, fail to repair every error, or introduce new faults.
过程评测器将 exact/set 错误类型计分与 LLM 语义评审混合，因此评审版本、提示敏感性、随机性与 API 漂移可改变描述/修复准确率。
当前代码默认 gpt-4o-mini，而论文写明 GPT-4.1-mini；未发布校准集或版本对账报告。
所声明的 0.7 相似度阈值未被所检查评测器使用；匹配改为使用硬编码的高于 0.5 的分数阈值以及评审模型自身的布尔值。
错误类型 precision/recall 使用错误类型集合，当 README 含多个相同类别错误时会折叠重复计数。
shell 脚本可通过可变的依赖/测试执行而依赖实时包状态；成功不能证明未来可回放、安全性，或每个诊断在语义上都正确。
多错误任务会复合失败：智能体可能识别类型但错过精确命令、未将建议修复纳入最终脚本、未能修复每个错误，或引入新故障。
